title: Film Credits Year Stamp
brief: A video post-production tool renders the closing credits of a film, and the studio's house style prints the copyright year and sequel numbers as Roman numerals.
Implement formatCreditYear(num), where num is the number to print, and return its Roman numeral as an uppercase string.
